articles.headline: UEFA moves Europa League game date in Rennes amid protests
articles.description: The prospect of a general strike in France next week amid national protests has pushed UEFA to change a Europa League match date in Rennes.

images.name: Paris riots damage [1296x729]
images.caption: The Statue de la Republique in Paris wears a yellow vest in the aftermath of clashes between riot police and demonstrators during nationwide protests in France.

articles.headline: AC Milan condemn racist abuse of Mike Maignan after red card vs. Bournemouth
articles.description: AC Milan have condemned what they called "serious and unacceptable racist abuse" directed at goalkeeper Mike Maignan on social media following his red card in Thursday's Europa League loss to Bournemouth.

images.name: Mike Maignan Milan [1296x729]
images.caption: Mike Maignan was shown a red card in AC Milan's loss to Bournemouth.
images.alt: Mike Maignan of AC Milan prepares ahead of Bournemouth's first penalty during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD3 match between AFC Bournemouth and AC Milan at Bournemouth Stadium on October 22, 2026 in Bournemouth, England.

articles.headline: 'If Mo Salah scores three...' - Hearts boss on puzzle to mark Trabzonspor star
articles.description: Wouter Vrancken hailed auxiliary left-back Rogers Mato for the way he stepped into the breach against Mohamed Salah as injury-hit Hearts produced a spirited display in a 2-0 Conference League defeat away to Trabzonspor.

images.name: Mohamed Salah [1296x729]
images.caption: 'Watch me play over there, on ESPN in Africa!' - Mohamed Salah... probably.

images.name: Rogers Mato [1296x729]
images.caption: Rogers Mato stepped in to play left back against Mohamed Salah
images.alt: Batista Mendy (L) of Trabzonspor in action against Rogers Mato of Hearts during UEFA Conference League week 2 football match between Trabzonspor and Hearts at Papara Park in Trabzon, Turkiye on October 22, 2026.
images.credit: Hakan Burak Altunoz/Anadolu via Getty Images

articles.headline: Rose urges humility after Bournemouth rout Milan as Amorim rues red card
articles.description: Marco Rose said his Bournemouth team will stay humble after they dominated AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League while Ruben Amorim said the match was over as a contest for his team after Mike Maignan's red card in the first half.

images.name: Bournemouth celeb vs Milan [1296x729]
images.caption: Amine Adli of Bournemouth celebrates scoring their third goal with Adrien Truffert during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD3 match between AFC Bournemouth and AC Milan at Bournemouth Stadium on October 22, 2026 in Bournemouth, England.
images.alt: Amine Adli of Bournemouth celebrates scoring their third goal with Adrien Truffert during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD3 match between AFC Bournemouth and AC Milan at Bournemouth Stadium on October 22, 2026 in Bournemouth, England.

images.name: Before 'the special one', José Mourinho was 'the Barca one'
images.caption: Before 'the special one', José Mourinho was 'the Barca one'

articles.headline: Bournemouth fairytale condemns Ruben Amorim to another nightmare in England
articles.description: Bournemouth never wanted this night to end. Ruben Amorim, however, would be happy to forget this evening on the south coast ever happened.

images.name: Ruben Amorim, Head Coach of AC Milan [1296x729]
images.credit: Alex Pantling - UEFA/UEFA via Getty Images

images.name: Mike Maignan of AC Milan [1296x729]
images.caption: There was no shortage of drama on the south coast as Milan goalkeeper Mike Maignan was sent off.
images.credit: Robin Jones - AFC Bournemouth/AFC Bournemouth via Getty Images
